packet.title: XPath front end: CST to AST (implementation)

body.p: After . Owns src/xpath_parse.c, tests/xpath_parse_test.c. Any ERROR or MISSING is XPST0003 with a location; the checks leaves to the builder (A.3.2 delimitation, prefixed lookup key); literals decoded. Done when all 198 slice queries build an AST and every XP40 query that tools/qt4-parse-check.py accepts also builds one. Done 2026-10-16 (): also src/xpath_ast.c () and tests/xpath_ast_test.c; 198/198 slice queries and 32,542/32,542 valid XP40 queries build, the two false accepts now fail with XPST0003.
